title: IMAP AdminConfig parsed but never acted upon
description: imap/config.rs defines AdminConfig with enabled, addr, and admin_token fields. main.rs parses it but never starts an admin listener or uses admin_token. An operator who sets admin.enabled=true and admin.admin_token in their config will get no admin endpoint and no error or warning — silent misconfiguration. Either implement the admin endpoint, or remove AdminConfig from the IMAP config until it is implemented.
